sentences.en: They make used cooking oil into soap at that factory.
sentences.zh: 他们在那家工厂将用过的烹饪油制成肥皂。

sentences.en: I prefer soap as a liquid rather than a bar.
sentences.zh: 我更喜欢液体状的肥皂而不是固体块状的。

sentences.en: Don't curse or I'll wash your mouth out with soap.
sentences.zh: 不要骂人，否则我要用水和肥皂给你洗嘴。

senses.zh: 将肥皂涂在……上；对……拍马屁（俚语）
